result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate on 30 days’ notice with a refund of prepaid fees allocable to the post-termination period, while Kubient may terminate for convenience only at the end of the then-current term on 90 days’ notice. However, allowing Customer to terminate any Exhibit, in whole or in part, goes beyond what the playbook requires and may materially expand partial-termination rights. The retained fees-during-notice language is generally compatible with the refund obligation, though “then-current Term” and “termination period” could be drafted more precisely.
